result: All 13 pass document validation after corrections; reviewable logical proposals with implementation and activation gates still open.

corrections.change: Added explicit acceptance evidence for reused implementations: source build, local changes, gaps, owner and qualification.
Added the reader guide and plain-language terms used in the other specs.
Clarified that each ready exchange action executes only its named delivery or public-copy submission.
Made the lost-response rule explicit for recovery calls that may change provider state, with an acceptance scenario.
Corrected the article in “an action” after the terminology replacement.
Clarified Domain Services as the broader group containing E-Invoice Service, Tax Service and other domain services.

manual_handoff_review.result: Authority, credentials, readiness and route activation remain separate; unqualified operations remain gated.
ERP owns issuance; final bytes/profile and route are checked again; mapping does not replace final validation.
Exact source capture and permitted download remain separate from mapping/product success; retrieval progress requires durable item outcomes, not ERP acknowledgement.
Raw evidence and independent outcomes are retained; a receipt, download or delivery result does not prove buyer acceptance or payment.
Earlier work keeps its original context; current authority, approved actors, retention and exit checks govern continued access and closure.

coverage_signal_interpretation.SPEC-SEI-005: External unknown-outcome reconciliation is not this validator’s dispatch responsibility. It blocks on missing/pending validation and delegates external sending to exchange.
coverage_signal_interpretation.SPEC-SEI-010: The side-effecting recovery-call failure row and RSD-A16 explicitly cover lost responses, original-operation reconciliation and safe checkpoint handling. The text-search indicator misses their wording.
coverage_signal_interpretation.SPEC-SEI-012: Stateful-query uncertainty and original-operation reconciliation are covered by RLU-A15; the text search indicator is narrower than that wording.

limitations: Acceptance scenarios describe evidence to obtain; they are not executed implementation tests.
Internal service sources, real builds, deployed environments and all provider contracts were not independently verified.
Primary-source spot-checks cover selected assumptions, not a complete legal or compliance review.
The repository document-validation workflow is currently a placeholder; this audit is not an established automated CI gate.
Saved Confluence export snapshots retain their historical wording; active specs and current diagram assets were reviewed.
Publication was authorised separately after validation. All 13 specs are selected for Confluence publication and remain draft designs; publication does not approve implementation.
overall_document_recommendation: Keep the continuous diagram and its reading guide as the overall navigation. The existing specs own the reviewed handoffs; a further overall solution spec is not needed for this review.
